text: Hoc Roboamo annum quintum regnante, Sesacus, Aegypti rex, expeditionem fecit in Hierosolymam,
note: proofread: the apposition *Ægyptī rēx* closed with a comma after *rēx* (*Sesacus, Ægyptī rēx, expedītiōnem fēcit*), since r6's comma for 1738's semicolon opened it and left it open, so the title read into the verb; otherwise r6's row (proofreader p3, 2026-11-22)

text: Quamquam propter Davidem Jova, Deus ejus, ei lucernam concessit Hierosolymis, ejus filio post eum substituendo, ut Hierosolymam stabiliret:
note: proofread: the apposition *Deus ejus* closed with a comma after *ejus* (*Jōva, Deus ejus, eī lucernam concessit*), as 1738 opens it with a comma after *Ioua* and leaves it open, so *ejus eī* ran together; Hebrew יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו (proofreader p3, 2026-11-22)
